common_behaviors_actions: Plotting intricate schemes to gain more power.
Studying ancient tomes of forbidden knowledge.
Seeking out artifacts and relics of immense power.
Vecna.name: Vecna
Vecna.damage_resistances: necrotic, cold, bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
Vecna.languages: Common, Draconic, Infernal, Elvish, telepathy 120 ft.
special_abilities: Undying Mastery: Vecna can never be truly destroyed as long as his phylactery remains intact.
Legendary Spellcasting: Vecna can cast spells as a 20th-level wizard and has access to all necromancy spells.

legendary_actions.Cast a Spell: Vecna casts one of his prepared spells.
legendary_actions.Hand of Vecna: Vecna can make a melee attack with the Hand of Vecna, dealing necrotic damage.

lair_actions: Vecna can cast the spell 'detect magic' without using a spell slot.
Vecna can cause spectral hands to rise from the ground and restrain a creature.
regional_effects: Dead creatures within 1 mile of Vecna's lair cannot be resurrected except by wish.
The area within 1 mile of Vecna's lair is shrouded in perpetual twilight.

common_behaviors_actions: Obsessively watching over Barovia.
Seeking out and manipulating Tatyana's reincarnations.
Holding court in Castle Ravenloft.
Strahd.name: Strahd
Strahd.damage_resistances: necrotic, bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
special_abilities: Shapechanger: Strahd can polymorph into a bat, wolf, or mist.
Vampiric Regeneration: Strahd regains hit points each round as long as he has at least 1 hit point.

legendary_actions.Move: Strahd can move up to his speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
legendary_actions.Unholy Sword: Strahd makes a melee attack with his Unholy Sword.

lair_actions: Strahd can summon a swarm of bats or rats to aid him in combat.
Strahd can cause shadows to darken within his lair, imposing disadvantage on attack rolls against him.
regional_effects: The area within 6 miles of Castle Ravenloft is perpetually covered in mist.
Strahd can exert control over Barovia, spying on its inhabitants and influencing events.

common_behaviors_actions: Relentlessly seeking ways to escape Ravenloft.
Experimenting with necromantic magic.
Ruling Darkon with a cold, iron fist.
Azalin.name: Azalin
Azalin.damage_resistances: necrotic, cold, bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
Azalin.languages: Common, Draconic, Infernal, Elvish, telepathy 120 ft.
special_abilities: Undying Will: Azalin can never be truly destroyed as long as his phylactery remains intact.
Legendary Spellcasting: Azalin can cast spells as a 20th-level wizard and has access to all necromancy spells.

legendary_actions.Cast a Spell: Azalin casts one of his prepared spells.
legendary_actions.Paralyzing Touch: Azalin can make a melee attack that paralyzes his target.

lair_actions: Azalin can create an anti-magic field in a 30-foot radius around him.
Azalin can cause the dead to rise from the ground and fight for him.
regional_effects: Undead creatures within 1 mile of Azalin's lair gain resistance to necrotic damage.
The area within 1 mile of Azalin's lair is shrouded in a permanent fog, reducing visibility.

common_behaviors_actions: Brooding over his past sins.
Riding his nightmare steed across the land.
Seeking out powerful artifacts to increase his power.
Soth.name: Soth
Soth.damage_resistances: necrotic, fire, bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
special_abilities: Aura of Fear: Enemies within 10 feet of Soth must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute.
Hellfire Orb: Soth can hurl an orb of hellfire that explodes on impact, dealing fire and necrotic damage.

legendary_actions.Move: Soth can move up to his speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
legendary_actions.Hellfire Orb: Soth can use his Hellfire Orb ability as a legendary action.

lair_actions: Soth can summon ghostly knights to fight for him.
Soth can create a wall of flame that deals fire damage to creatures that pass through it.
regional_effects: The area within 1 mile of Soth's lair is filled with the sound of distant wailing and screams.
Undead creatures within 1 mile of Soth's lair gain advantage on saving throws against being turned.

common_behaviors_actions: Guarding his tomb with relentless vigilance.
Cursing those who would steal from his burial chamber.
Commanding the sands to swallow intruders.
Atemu-Ra.name: Atemu-Ra
Atemu-Ra.damage_resistances: necrotic, bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
special_abilities: Mummy Rot: Atemu-Ra's touch can inflict a curse that causes the victim's body to wither and rot.
Desert's Curse: Atemu-Ra can summon a sandstorm to obscure vision and deal necrotic damage.

legendary_actions.Blinding Sand: Atemu-Ra can summon sand to blind his enemies.
legendary_actions.Desert's Curse: Atemu-Ra can use his Desert's Curse ability as a legendary action.

lair_actions: Atemu-Ra can animate the dead within his tomb to rise as mummies or skeletons.
Atemu-Ra can cause the sands to shift, creating difficult terrain or causing creatures to sink.
regional_effects: The area within 1 mile of Atemu-Ra's tomb is covered in a perpetual sandstorm.
Any water sources within 1 mile of the tomb become fouled and undrinkable.

common_behaviors_actions: Raising legions of undead to serve him.
Seeking dark artifacts to increase his power.
Scouring battlefields for souls to consume.
Azoth.name: Azoth
Azoth.damage_resistances: necrotic, bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
special_abilities: Life Drain: Azoth's attacks drain life from his enemies, healing him for the damage dealt.
Soul Rend: Azoth can tear the soul from a living creature, adding it to his collection.

legendary_actions.Shadow Step: Azoth can teleport through shadows to an unoccupied space he can see.
legendary_actions.Life Drain: Azoth can use his Life Drain ability as a legendary action.

lair_actions: Azoth can summon shadows or specters to assist him in combat.
Azoth can fill his lair with necrotic energy, dealing damage to all living creatures within.
regional_effects: The area within 1 mile of Azoth's lair is cloaked in perpetual darkness.
Living creatures that die within 1 mile of Azoth's lair have a 50% chance of rising as wights under his control.

common_behaviors_actions: Draining the life force of any who enter his domain.
Manipulating shadows to ensnare and corrupt.
Plotting to expand his influence beyond the ethereal.
Khen-Zai.name: Khen-Zai
Khen-Zai.damage_resistances: necrotic, cold, bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
Khen-Zai.condition_immunities: charmed, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, poisoned, prone, restrained
special_abilities: Incorporeal Movement: Khen-Zai can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain.
Necrotic Touch: Khen-Zai's touch can drain the life from his enemies, weakening them with necrotic energy.

legendary_actions.Etherealness: Khen-Zai can move into the Ethereal Plane and return to the Material Plane at will.
legendary_actions.Necrotic Touch: Khen-Zai can use his Necrotic Touch ability as a legendary action.

lair_actions: Khen-Zai can cause shadows to animate and attack intruders.
Khen-Zai can cast darkness at will within his lair, extinguishing all light.
regional_effects: The area within 1 mile of Khen-Zai's lair is filled with oppressive gloom, reducing natural light levels by half.
Creatures that sleep within 1 mile of Khen-Zai's lair are plagued by nightmares.

common_behaviors_actions: Leading armies of ghouls in unholy conquests.
Desecrating sacred sites and consuming the dead.
Spreading the curse of undeath wherever he goes.
Doresain.name: Doresain
Doresain.damage_resistances: necrotic, bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
special_abilities: Ghoul's Claw: Doresain's claws can paralyze living creatures with a single strike.
Unholy Bite: Doresain can bite a creature, draining its life force and spreading ghoul fever.

legendary_actions.Ravenous Bite: Doresain can make an Unholy Bite attack as a legendary action.
legendary_actions.Ghoul's Claw: Doresain can use his Ghoul's Claw ability as a legendary action.

lair_actions: Doresain can summon a wave of ghouls to attack intruders.
Doresain can cause the ground to erupt with necrotic energy, damaging all living creatures within range.
regional_effects: The area within 1 mile of Doresain's lair is tainted with the stench of death, causing living creatures to become sickened.
Corpses within 1 mile of Doresain's lair are animated as ghouls under his control.

common_behaviors_actions: Haunting the halls of her ancestral home.
Tormenting those who carry her family's bloodline.
Using her powers to manipulate and deceive the living.
Morgana.name: Morgana
Morgana.damage_resistances: necrotic, cold, bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
Morgana.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, poisoned, prone, restrained
special_abilities: Horrifying Visage: Morgana can cause any creature that sees her to become frightened.
Withering Touch: Morgana's touch drains the life from her enemies.

legendary_actions.Ghostly Presence: Morgana can become invisible until she attacks or casts a spell.
legendary_actions.Withering Touch: Morgana can use her Withering Touch ability as a legendary action.

lair_actions: Morgana can cause doors and windows to slam shut and lock within her lair.
Morgana can summon spectral hands to grasp at intruders, reducing their movement speed.
regional_effects: The area within 1 mile of Morgana's lair is haunted by ghostly apparitions and eerie whispers.
Creatures that sleep within 1 mile of Morgana's lair experience disturbing dreams that prevent restful sleep.

common_behaviors_actions: Patrolling the battlefield where he fell.
Protecting the land from those who would defile it.
Seeking justice for the unfulfilled vow that binds him.
Valen.name: Valen
Valen.damage_resistances: necrotic, bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
Valen.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, poisoned, prone, restrained
special_abilities: Terrifying Glare: Valen can force a creature to make a Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute.
Vengeful Strike: Valen can deal extra necrotic damage on his attacks against those who have wronged him.

legendary_actions.Vengeful Pursuit: Valen can move up to his speed towards a target he is pursuing.
legendary_actions.Vengeful Strike: Valen can use his Vengeful Strike ability as a legendary action.

lair_actions: Valen can summon spectral knights to assist him in battle.
Valen can create an aura of dread, imposing disadvantage on saving throws against being frightened.
regional_effects: The area within 1 mile of Valen's lair is cloaked in an eerie fog that muffles sound.
The spirits of the fallen within 1 mile of Valen's lair are restless, occasionally manifesting as ghostly figures.
